acceptanceMatrix.preservationRule: Every Area + Cheapest falsifier pair is carried forward as a qualification method unless a later accepted Design explicitly changes it. Observed evidence cells are historical observations and are not copied as current qualification state.

sourceGateConflict.problem: Two live owners currently describe different source-gate breadth. B must select one qualification owner and make AGENTS reference it rather than retaining a second command list.

liveReferenceInventory.rule: Maintained live references that intend the current qualification owner must be updated atomically at the owner swap. Historical/evidence strings that accurately record docs/MVP.md remain untouched.

ownerSwapPreconditions: D0032 (or another fresh next ID if authority changes before acceptance) is accepted before Class 2 owner mutation.
The source-gate conflict is resolved explicitly.
A byte-identical historical preservation of this exact docs/MVP.md is proven before deleting the live path.
All 78 acceptance matrix methods are preserved in the replacement qualification owner or explicitly superseded by accepted Design text.
Observed evidence, pass counts, benchmarks and old completion narrative are not promoted into current authority.
Maintained live references are swapped in the same transition so only one live qualification owner remains.
unresolvedBeforeB1: Which source-gate command set is the canonical qualification contract: the narrower historical MVP block or the broader current AGENTS minimum gate? This is a Class 2 acceptance-method decision and cannot be inferred from passing tests.
